newsitem.title: ITALY: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-PROFILE OF WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM WINNER.

text.p: Profile of the winner of a women's World Cup giant slalom on Sunday:
Previous World Cup wins: 10 - Giant slalom: Tignes, Veysonnaz 1993, Morzine 1994, Haus 1995, Narvik 1996, Zwiesel (2) 1997. Super-G: Morzine 1992, Morzine 1993. Slalom: Semmering 1996.

Other facts: Olympic super-G champion in 1992 and giant champion in 1994, becoming the first Italian woman to complete an Olympic double. World giant champion in 1996. Was world junior giant slalom champion at age of 17 but her career has been marked by numerous injuries and illnesses. Missed the first nine races of the 1994-95 season because of a kidney infection and had repeated knee surgery. Trained with compatriot Alberto Tomba in the early days of her career.
